title: phegopteris engleriana
intro: Phegopteris engleriana, commonly known as Chinese maidenhair fern, is a type of flowering plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as lowering blood pressure, improving digestion, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Phegopteris engleriana include sedative and antispasmodic effects, which can help to calm the nervous system and alleviate muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
